message: 🚨 ALERT: user-service error rate >5% — current: 12%. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/user-svc
Ack. Looking at it now. Seeing a spike in 503s from user-service.
DB connection pool is at 100%. All connections seem stuck. Checking what changed.
I deployed v2.14.0 about 30 minutes ago. It had a change to the user lookup query — added a JOIN to the preferences table.
Found it. The deploy removed the connection timeout setting from the config. Connections are being acquired but never released when queries hang.
Oh no. I refactored the DB config module and the timeout wasn't in the new config schema. It was in a legacy block I removed.
I'm going to hotfix the config to add connection_timeout=5s and idle_timeout=60s. Not rolling back the full deploy since the query change itself is fine.
Sounds good. Customer support is getting tickets. Can we get an ETA?
Hotfix deployed. Pool is draining. Should be back to normal in 2-3 minutes.
Confirmed: error rate back to 0%. All endpoints healthy. Total impact was about 18 minutes.
Thanks everyone. Let's write up a post-mortem. We should add a config validation check in CI.
